description: Source code implementing Redis's eviction policies, including LRU and LFU, with functions for managing eviction pools, calculating object idle times, and performing memory eviction to adhere to maxmemory limits.

methods.name: getLRUClock
methods.description: Returns the current LRU clock based on system time and clock resolution.

methods.name: LRU_CLOCK
methods.description: Obtains the current LRU clock, using atomic get if needed.

methods.name: estimateObjectIdleTime
methods.description: Estimates how long an object has been idle using an LRU approximation.

methods.name: evictionPoolAlloc
methods.description: Allocates and initializes the eviction pool.

methods.name: evictionPoolPopulate
methods.description: Populates the eviction pool with candidate keys for eviction based on idle time or LFU policy.

methods.name: LFUGetTimeInMinutes
methods.description: Returns current time in minutes for LFU calculations.

methods.name: LFUTimeElapsed
methods.description: Calculates elapsed time in minutes since last LFU decrement time, handling overflow.

methods.name: LFUDecrAndReturn
methods.description: Decrements LFU counter of an object based on elapsed time and returns the current frequency count.

methods.name: overMaxmemoryAfterAlloc
methods.description: Checks if allocating additional memory would exceed maxmemory limit.

methods.name: performEvictions
methods.description: Performs memory eviction to stay within maxmemory, using various policies and eviction pools.
